label: madashimo
title: まだしも
meaning: would be much better, would be acceptable だったら、ほかのよりいい
meaning_example: If it was next month that would be better, but it isn't going to happen until next year.

examples.japanese: 一度ならまだしもここまで六回その言葉を間違えって書いた。
examples.body_text:
一度ならまだしもここまで六回その言葉を間違えって書いた。 

		Once would be acceptable, but you've misspelled that word six times now.
examples.body_html:
一度ならまだしもここまで六回その言葉を間違えって書いた。 
Once would be acceptable, but you've misspelled that word six times now.

examples.japanese: この方がまだしもあれよりよい。
examples.body_text:
この方がまだしもあれよりよい。 

		This would be better than that.
examples.body_html:
この方がまだしもあれよりよい。  
This would be better than that.

examples.japanese: こんなひどい目に合うよりまだしも死んだほうがよい。
examples.body_text:
こんなひどい目に合うよりまだしも死んだほうがよい。 

		I would rather die than have such a terrible experience.
examples.body_html:
こんなひどい目に合うよりまだしも死んだほうがよい。  
I would rather die than have such a terrible experience.

examples.japanese: すうじつならまだしも１０日も滞納している。
examples.body_text:
すうじつならまだしも１０日も滞納している。  

		A few days would have been excusable but you are in arrears for 10 days.
examples.body_html:
すうじつならまだしも１０日も滞納している。  
A few days would have been excusable but you are in arrears for 10 days.

comments.text:
often appears with "nara" in front, meaning "(if it were this) then that would be OK, but..."

This was a correct answer on the 1kyuu in 2005.
